mechanism_narrative: A sustained year-over-year CPI inflation rate above 3.0% compresses real equity valuations by increasing the real discount rate, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where YoY CPIAUCSL > 3.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points from the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with UNRATE increase > 0.2pp over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous contraction in housing starts (HOUST) and rising consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) signal a dual shock to demand and inflation expectations, triggering a flight to quality and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST decline and CPIAUCSL rise fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 40% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In active monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 signals an imminent economic slowdown that triggers central bank policy easing, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and INDPRO < 100.0 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 over three consecutive months signals weakening economic activity that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of quarters where INDPRO remains below 100.0 for three months over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1400.0 thousand units signals strong consumer demand that boosts corporate sales and profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with HOUST > 1400.0 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%), a monthly increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 signals tight labor market conditions that drive wage inflation and corporate cost pressures, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS > 200,000 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in real personal consumption (RSAFS) and rising consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) signal a strong demand environment with persistent inflation, leading to aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of RSAFS growth and CPIAUCSL rise fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 40% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.
